description_en: Deletes a media workflow. This does not affect workflow instances that are running
name: DeleteMediaWorkflow

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media workflow that you want to delete. To obtain the ID of the media workflow, you can log on to the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console and choose Workflows > Workflow Settings in the left-side navigation pane
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的媒体工作流ID，可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 工作流设置获取
parameters.name: media_workflow_id
